questions.en: How many German North Sea islands have a car-train (motorail shuttle) connection?

timeline.labelEn: The Hindenburgdamm opens, linking the island of Sylt to the mainland by rail
timeline.labelDe: Der Hindenburgdamm wird eröffnet und verbindet die Insel Sylt per Bahn mit dem Festland

questions.notes: Only Sylt: car trains run Niebüll–Westerland over the Hindenburgdamm; the other German North Sea islands are reached by ferry (or are car-free).

questions.de: In welchem Land wurde das Schengener Abkommen unterzeichnet?
questions.en: In which country was the Schengen Agreement signed?

timeline.labelEn: Five EC states sign the first Schengen Agreement at Schengen, Luxembourg
timeline.labelDe: Fünf EG-Staaten unterzeichnen das erste Schengener Abkommen in Schengen, Luxemburg

questions.notes: Card offered Luxemburg / Belgien / Frankreich; reworked to an open question. Signed in the Luxembourg village of Schengen.
